releases.notes:
# PlayerLog v1.0.0

Initial release of PlayerLog.

## Features

* Player damage notifications
* Low-health notifications
* Drowning detection
* Creeper threat detection
* Fire, fall, and projectile damage detection
* Configurable notification cooldowns
* Configurable notification recipients
* Clickable teleport buttons
* JSON configuration
* `/playerlog` and `/pl` commands

## Commands

* `/pl` — Show PlayerLog status
* `/pl help` — Show available commands
* `/pl enable` — Enable PlayerLog
* `/pl disable` — Disable PlayerLog
* `/pl reload` — Reload the configuration
* `/pl tp <player>` — Teleport to a player

## Requirements

* Minecraft 26.2
* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API

This is the initial release of PlayerLog.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Mintype/PlayerLog/commits/v1.0.0
